senses.gloss: f. (= תואריתא, dimin. of תּוֹאַר) the least form or aspect of.
units: <cite ref="Menachot 75b:11">Men. 75ᵇ</cite> <he>והוא דאיכא ת׳ דנהמא עלייהו</he> (Ms. R. <he>תואריתא</he>; Ms. C. <he>תוארייתא</he>; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 400) provided they still have some semblance of bread (not altogether reduced to a pap); <cite ref="Berakhot 37b:10">Ber. 37ᵇ</cite>
